week.text_002: Parents check their own balances instead of emailing you.
week.text_003: Permission slips and forms send their own reminders until they come back signed.

week.text_005: Seating charts and Skill Pathways pull from your roster, so you never retype names.

packet.text_029: One yearly price per program, with every feature, and we can import your existing records for you. Need a quote, a W-9 or a vendor form for purchasing? We'll send it.
packet.text_031: Program Partner · Prepared for Westbrook School District
packet.text_034: Each program's records are walled off from every other program's, enforced in the database itself.
packet.text_036: Staff see only the areas their job needs: a booster treasurer sees the books, an assistant sees attendance.
packet.text_038: Student and family data is never sold, never used for advertising, and never shared with outside analytics trackers.
packet.text_040: We sign a data privacy agreement with your district, or review the one your district already uses.
packet.text_042: When a program leaves, we return its records on request, then delete them within 45 days. Backup copies expire within 30 days after that.
